findings.finding: Fog coverage is inferred from brightness, desaturation, local contrast and depth. This is an image-space estimate, not access to the engine fog volume or a participating-media simulation.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.

findings.finding: Light/emission coverage is inferred from luminance, peak channel and saturation thresholds; it is not an engine material-emission classification.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.

findings.finding: The inspected path combines custom directional smoothing with horizontal, vertical and diagonal neighborhood blends. FXAA/SMAA-style labels do not establish canonical FXAA or full SMAA algorithm equivalence.
findings.wording: Custom directional and edge-aware neighborhood anti-aliasing approximation.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.

findings.finding: The inspected offset uses a finite, explicitly expanded chain of direction transforms and fixed weights. Its recursive/bio/Fibonacci naming does not establish adaptive recursive image processing or a biological model.
findings.wording: Finite golden-ratio-inspired direction and sampling construction.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.

findings.finding: The inspected path samples offset screen color/depth and aggregates bright depth-compatible samples. Ray-M/gloss naming alone does not establish physically correct reflection tracing or access to hidden/off-screen geometry.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.

findings.classification: source-confirmed validity-policy concern; runtime consequence unverified
findings.finding: The presence helper tests nonzero mask content, while the nonzero cache modes select shared-cache use without establishing freshness in these helpers. Valid zero coverage must be distinguished from missing data; capture order and lifetime need independent evidence.
findings.wording: Shared mask selection with a separately required availability/freshness contract.
findings.evidence: Source inspection only; native compile, runtime equivalence and performance not established by this record.
